- **JC-2026-00009, Laser Cut, LASER-01 (6kW Fiber Laser)** — open, never started (started_at null), waiting since 2026-07-23 (90 days). The remaining cards are equally untouched: JC-2026-00010 Form/Brake (BRAKE-02), JC-2026-00011 Robotic Weld (WELD-03), JC-2026-00012 Powder Coat (COAT-06).
